_comment: Data-driven benign false-positive gate. 'harnesses' expands to one case per harness (id@harness). 'pending_fix' lists expanded case ids known to fail on the Linux CI host until the named fix lands; on CI the test fails if a listed case unexpectedly passes, so remove entries as fixes merge. 'pending_pr' names the in-flight PR that fixes each pending case ('unassigned' if none). 'pending_always' lists review cases whose approval row is expected to lack an Always option until #3961 lands; any other review row for read-only git, file reads or tool reads must offer Always. A plain 'git push' is not modeled here: Guard proves a push only when the shell HOME is the account's home, and this gate runs with a fixture HOME. rust/crates/guard-command/tests/pretool_git_push.rs covers the accepted pushes and the forms that keep their review.
